head: dwṣ (< MEA dbṣ cf. SL 270: to sting, bite;)

examples.translation: niemand ist da, der deine Söhne gebissen hat
examples.raw: layt nošo d-dwuṣle abnux ʻniemand ist da, der deine Söhne gebissen hatʼ; 448; prs 102/34, 36;

examples.turoyo: zbəṭla iḏe bayn-l-a=tre ṣawʕoṯe (…) w-lo=marfela hul d-lo=hiye grəšle iḏe w-grišole, qalibo, dwəṣla
examples.translation: It (snake, f.) gripped his hand between his two fingers and did not let go until he pulled his hand out and (with it) pulled it (snake, f.). Then, it (snake, f.) turned over and bit (him)
examples.raw: zbəṭla iḏe bayn-l-a=tre ṣawʕoṯe (…) w-lo=marfela hul d-lo=hiye grəšle iḏe w-grišole, qalibo, dwəṣla ‘It (snake, f.) gripped his hand between his two fingers and did not let go until he pulled his hand out and (with it) pulled it (snake, f.). Then, it (snake, f.) turned over and bit (him)’ LuF 296-298/40;

examples.translation: sie biss ihn mit dem Kopfe zwischen den Augen
examples.raw: g-dawṣo b-qarʕa bayn ʕayne ʻsie biss ihn mit dem Kopfe zwischen den Augenʼ; 453; prs 213/25;

examples.turoyo: haṯe i=naqla d-ko-duṣo isān lo=ko-xoləṣ mina
examples.translation: Whenever this (snake, f.) bites a man, he can not save himself
examples.raw: haṯe i=naqla d-ko-duṣo isān lo=ko-xoləṣ mina ‘Whenever this (snake, f.) bites a man, he can not save himself’ LuF 288/4;

examples.translation: wenn der (Skorpion f) einen Menschen stach, dann starb er sofort
examples.raw: u=ḥa d-duṣó-way-le b-naqqa moyaṯ-wa ʻwenn der (Skorpion f) einen Menschen stach, dann starb er sofortʼ JL 7.7.6;

examples.turoyo: kul=ḥa mičək-wa b-u=bayto, w-fulti-wa bəṯran hul l-gawe=d-ab=bote w-hənne g-duṣi-way-lan
examples.translation: Every one (of us) got into the house, but they (bees, pl.) chased us even inside the houses, and some of them bit us
examples.raw: kul=ḥa mičək-wa b-u=bayto, w-fulti-wa bəṯran hul l-gawe=d-ab=bote w-hənne g-duṣi-way-lan ‘Every one (of us) got into the house, but they (bees, pl.) chased us even inside the houses, and some of them bit us’ 72/9-10;

examples.translation: He was bitten by a snake
examples.raw: dwiṣ b-i=kurfo ‘He was bitten by a snake’ LuF 298/42;

examples.translation: sie wollte ihn beissen, aber er konnte nicht gebissen werden
examples.raw: g-dawṣlo-le, lo=k-mədwəṣ ʻsie wollte ihn beissen, aber er konnte nicht gebissen werdenʼ; 458; prs 103/17; prs 251/20;

examples.turoyo: arbʕo ḥamšo=yawme kul=lalyo m-al=lalye d-alo ʕezo w-ko-mədwoṣo
examples.translation: For four or five days, every night a goat was bitten
examples.raw: arbʕo ḥamšo=yawme kul=lalyo m-al=lalye d-alo ʕezo w-ko-mədwoṣo ‘For four or five days, every night a goat was bitten’ LuF 304/69;

examples.turoyo: aloho maṣṭar-wa, b-am=mo təšʕi w tašʕo-ze har lo=mədwoṣi-wa
examples.translation: Gott beschützte (uns), denn in neunundneunzig von hundert Fällen wurde niemand gebissen
examples.raw: aloho maṣṭar-wa, b-am=mo təšʕi w tašʕo-ze har lo=mədwoṣi-wa ʻGott beschützte (uns), denn in neunundneunzig von hundert Fällen wurde niemand gebissenʼ JL 7.7.11;

examples.turoyo: dwəṣla b-raġle laltaḥ m-i=barko, qoyəm gorəš i=xanǧar, zobəṭ dukṯe d-feme d-i=kurfo d-i=dwaṣto b-iḏe w-b-i=xanǧar qoṭaʕla
examples.translation: It (snake, f.) bit his leg, below his knee, so he took a dagger, grabbed the spot where he was bitten (lit. ‘grabbed the place of the snake’s mouth, of (its) biting’) with his hand and cut it out with the dagger
examples.raw: dwəṣla b-raġle laltaḥ m-i=barko, qoyəm gorəš i=xanǧar, zobəṭ dukṯe d-feme d-i=kurfo d-i=dwaṣto b-iḏe w-b-i=xanǧar qoṭaʕla ‘It (snake, f.) bit his leg, below his knee, so he took a dagger, grabbed the spot where he was bitten (lit. ‘grabbed the place of the snake’s mouth, of (its) biting’) with his hand and cut it out with the dagger’ LuF 302-304/63;
